subject.title: fix(workboard): decomposed children no longer block aggregate parents

question: Should Workboard permanently expose orchestration as the default decomposition semantics, plus the new repair gateway/tool APIs, rather than treating this as a narrower internal migration-only fix?
rationale: The branch changes persisted card meaning and adds public plugin operations; source-level correctness cannot determine the intended long-term Workboard contract.

options.title: Accept the new contract
options.body: Keep orchestration as the default for future decompositions, retain explicit hard mode, and require final-head upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Keep the legacy repair and diagnostics but remove or defer new public repair APIs until their plugin contract is explicitly designed.

options.title: Pause for Workboard design
options.body: Defer the PR until owners define the permanent decomposition and repair API contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the new contract
recommendation.body: Keep orchestration as the default for future decompositions, retain explicit hard mode, and require final-head upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable current-main Workboard owner was available in the provided review context; route through the Workboard plugin owner path.
